file_blobs.FS-4604.md:
# Field sheet FS-4604 — 3 Mill Leat, Ashcombe
Filed with site survey SS-4604 · R. Kessell, 2026-10-12

## Lie of the land
The house stands at the bottom of the combe beside the mill leat, where the lane ends. The ground rises on three sides to the open fields around the village; the leat and the lane run down to the house.
Ground level at the house: 61 m AOD.
Climate station named on the survey: ASH — Ashcombe, on open ground at 117 m.

## On the survey morning
Clear, still morning. Ground frost lay white on the garden and the roof until late morning, after the fields above had cleared.

## Roof and array
Roof: south-facing, pitch 34°, natural slate. Ridge and eaves measured; array layout set out from the ridge line with a 300 mm edge zone.

## Access
Scaffold from the front elevation; materials by the lane.
